items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: A Rico and a #2. ... Rico, yeah. You see, because I haven't been playing lately... Rico. They come in numbers.

ctx.x: A Number-two, you know. It's funny, I got that name. That name came to me. Rico, yeah. You see, because I haven't been playing lately... Rico. They come in numbers. So #2 satisfied me more than #2-1/2. #2-1/2 is a little bit too stiff for my mouthpiece, and with the #2 I could get the resonance that I wanted, you know.

Well, rather than me bother to shavin' reeds and cuttin' them down, I'd buy reeds by the boxes, and I didn't have no trouble. I had no trouble because the Number-Two fitted me pretty good. And I'd just put the reed on and go ahead and play it. And they lasted me quite a while. I was glad for that, because I was never successful shaving reeds. I mean, some people can do it, and do very good...
